subject: Clarify: implementation credit amortization vs per-seat HSM & audit-log tiers
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Murphy <sara.murphy@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify: implementation credit amortization vs per-seat HSM & audit-log tiers

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I’m attaching the pricing matrix (v3) and a draft SOW so your procurement team has concrete numbers to work from. High level we outlined three approaches that map to the commercial/implementation tradeoffs you mentioned:

- Option 1 — Amortized implementation credit: one-time implementation fees ($75k) are converted to a customer credit and amortized across months 1–12. This keeps upfront cost low while preserving predictable unit economics.
- Option 2 — Per-seat HSM model: pay for HSM seats (billed monthly) with a lower one-time implementation fee ($25k). This is simpler for our ops but can be costlier if seats stay reserved past pilot.
- Option 3 — Retention-tiered audit logs: 30 / 180 / 365 day retention tiers with step pricing (we show per-GB/month and a 1-year promotional discount for the first contract year).

Questions for you / procurement:
1) Do you have a hard preference for amortizing implementation costs vs per-seat billing?
2) If amortized, would you accept a 12-month window or do you need 6 months?
3) Any constraints on a 1-year promotional discount for the 365-day retention tier?

If helpful I can put together a short comparison showing total TCO at different utilization (pilot 100k tokens/day vs production 1M tokens/day).

Attachments: pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx (line-item breakout), SOW-draft.pdf (implementation milestones & acceptance).

Next steps: if procurement wants a reconciled spreadsheet we’ll update with the exact amortization schedule and return a revised SOW for signature.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193

From: Sara Murphy <sara.murphy@clarityhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Clarity Health Procurement <procurement@clarityhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 10:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Clarify: implementation credit amortization vs per-seat HSM & audit-log tiers

Ben —

Thanks for the materials and the clear options. Procurement has a few clarifying questions before we can route to legal:

- We prefer amortization from a cashflow perspective. Ideally 6 months, but we can consider 12 months if there’s an uplift to unit pricing.
- Can you provide a scenario where capacity scales down after month 6 (pilot finishes) and HSM seats are reduced without a large penalty? We want flexibility to right-size after pilot.
- Audit log retention: procurement prefers the 180-day tier as baseline. If we pick 365 days, we’d need a line-item discount for year 1 and an option to re-evaluate pricing at renewal.
- Please also confirm if residency for PHI will be enforced in the us-east-1 region only; we have some clinics with EU data flows but those are out-of-scope for this contract.

Can you get us a revised pricing sheet showing: (a) amortize $75k over 6 months vs 12 months, (b) HSM seat-per-month with a transitional 3-month discount, and (c) audit log 180 vs 365 with year-1 discount applied?

Procurement wants to see those figures before we send to legal and finance.

—Sara
Sara Murphy
Head of IT Procurement, Clarity Health
sara.murphy@clarityhealth.com | +1 (312) 555-0244

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 13:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Clarify pricing ask — recommended concession and safety rails

Team — forwarding Sara’s procurement note. My thoughts / suggested concession path:

1) Implementation credit: move to a $50k credit (down from $75k) amortized over 6 months. This meets their cashflow ask while preserving $25k of implementation revenue we can recognize or claw back if they churn before month 6. In the SOW include a clause that the credit is applied monthly against invoice and is forfeited if contract terminates within 6 months.

2) HSM seats: offer per-seat billing with a "transitional" discount: first 3 months at 40% off list, months 4–6 at 20% off, month 7 onward full list. Allow a one-time reduction of up to 30% of seats after month 6 (not more frequently). This gives flexibility but prevents gaming.

3) Audit logs: give a 15% year-1 discount on the 365-day tier if they commit to 12 months of Redwood Dedicated. Otherwise default to 180-day baseline pricing. Add a renewal review clause.

4) Residency: confirm PHI is locked to us-east-1; any EU flows must be explicitly scoped as an add-on.

If we agree internally I’ll draft an updated pricing_matrix_v4 and SOW-draft-v2 with the language above and include the amortization schedule. We can hold a 30-min sync with procurement if Sara wants a live walkthrough.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Murphy <sara.murphy@clarityhealth.com>, Clarity Health Procurement <procurement@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Apr 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify: implementation credit amortization vs per-seat HSM & audit-log tiers

Sara / Procurement —

Thanks for the clear asks. We discussed internally and can confirm the following concessions to move this forward:

- Implementation credit: $50,000 one-time credit amortized over 6 months, applied as a monthly invoice credit. Forfeitable if the contract terminates before month 6 (language in SOW).
- HSM seats: per-seat monthly billing with a transitional discount: 40% off months 1–3, 20% off months 4–6, then standard list. One-time seat reduction up to 30% after month 6.
- Audit logs: baseline will be 180-day retention. If Clarity elects 365-day retention and commits to a 12-month Redwood Dedicated contract, we’ll apply a 15% year-1 discount on the audit-log line items and include a renewal price review.
- Residency: PHI will be restricted to us-east-1 for this agreement; any EU-residency requirement must be scoped as an explicit add-on.

I’ve attached updated_pricing_matrix_v4.xlsx and SOW-draft-v2.pdf which reflect the amortization schedule and contractual language. Next steps:
1) If procurement confirms these bullets we’ll issue an updated commercial term sheet and a DocuSign envelope for the SOW (link below).
2) We can schedule a 30-min handshake between legal/procurement to walk through the SOW language if desired.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/CLAR-2028-04-01-sign
Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/pricing/CLAR/pricing_matrix_v4

Would appreciate a quick reply if this is acceptable so we can route to legal.

—Ben
